title: One Hides, One Lifts
caption:
Beauty Note — No. 06
One Hides, One Lifts

I often use two concealers, not one.

The first is slightly darker than the skin.
It covers dark circles, redness and small spots, only where they show.

The second is lighter.
I place it under the eyes in a soft triangle, and a little on the nose and eyelids.
It brings light to the face, and a natural lift.

One hides. One lifts.
In small amounts, together, they make the base look awake, not heavy.
